items.title: MC1479513: Outlook: Insert Symbols
items.summary: Starting mid-October 2026, Outlook will roll out the ability to insert symbols into emails via the Insert tab, completing by late January 2027. This feature affects users on new Outlook for Windows and web, requires no admin action, and enhances message composition with special characters.

items.summary: Microsoft Viva Engage will reduce email reply notifications by only sending alerts for direct replies, @mentions, and new posts, not for all conversation replies. The update rolls out globally from September to November 2026, requires no action, and keeps existing notification settings unchanged.

items.summary: A new Similar cases tab in the Microsoft Defender portal lists up to 20 related incidents by alert titles or entities, aiding analysts in identifying patterns. items.summary: Microsoft SharePoint will enhance data access governance reports and site access reviews starting late November 2026, giving admins better control to identify data risks, prioritize sites, direct review requests, and track email delivery. No action is required before rollout, but admins should prepare accordingly.

items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint will gain plugins to enhance capabilities with specialized skills and connectors, improving presentation workflows. Rolling out from May 2026 to January 2027 worldwide. No admin action required; default is off. Compliance recording is not supported with this feature.

Rolling out from mid-November 2026, it helps users access relevant training within Teams, enhancing AI fluency and confidence. Admins can manage notifications via Viva Learning settings.

items.summary: SharePoint will change how site logo URLs are updated in search metadata, stopping automatic updates of the SiteLogoUrl property on individual items. Rollout is from December 2026 to March 2027. Organizations using this property in search results should retrieve logos directly from the site instead.

items.title: MC1556090: Plugins in PowerPoint for Microsoft 365 Copilot [Win32]
items.summary: Plugins will be added to PowerPoint for Microsoft 365 Copilot on Windows, enhancing presentation capabilities with new skills and connectors. items.summary: Microsoft Teams will end support for iOS 17 and iPadOS 17 starting mid-December 2026, requiring iOS/iPadOS 18 or later for new releases. items.title: MC1551151: Microsoft Entra ID: Risk-based anti-bot verification (CAPTCHA) for SMS and voice multi-factor authentication
items.summary: Starting mid-November 2026, Microsoft Entra ID will add risk-based CAPTCHA verification for SMS and voice MFA to prevent automated fraud. Some users may need to complete CAPTCHA before receiving codes or calls. Administrators should prepare users, ensure network readiness, and promote phishing-resistant methods.
